contract: equation(X: np.ndarray[n, d], params: np.ndarray[10]) -> np.ndarray[n]; columns of X follow the instance's input_vars; parameters are fitted by BFGS on the train split. Score: mean NMSE on the test split over the selected LLM-SRBench instances
notes: Data from the public LLM-SRBench mirror pkuHaowei/llm-srbench; the fitting loop follows the LLM-SR evaluator. Whole-subset tasks use a seeded sample of four instances.
protocol_description: Reimplemented in this repository from the paper's task description; instances are generated locally with a fixed seed, so scores are comparable within the suite but not with the paper's numbers.
